task_description: Fix visual bug on login page where input placeholder/label directly overlaps entered or autofilled credentials, and resolve first character swallowed bug when typing in the input box.
root_causes: Floating label state in FloatingInput.jsx was exclusively conditioned on React state (isFloating = focused || hasValue). When browser autofill or password managers populated inputs natively, React Hook Form retained value: empty string, leaving the label unfloated and centered at top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 directly over credentials.
CSS lacked peer selectors for :not(:placeholder-shown) and :-webkit-autofill to elevate labels at the browser compositor level.

An internal native DOM event listener el.addEventListener("input", checkDomValue) calling setHasDomValue(true) caused synchronous re-renders of FloatingInput during the first keypress while the parent controller still held value: empty string, causing input value to reset the native DOM value and swallow the first typed character ("b" -> empty string).
modifications: client/src/index.css: Added pure CSS floating label rules for .floating-input:focus ~ .floating-label, .floating-input:not(:placeholder-shown) ~ .floating-label, .floating-input:-webkit-autofill ~ .floating-label, and .floating-label-active (top: 0.5rem !important, transform: translateY(0) scale(0.75) !important).

client/src/components/ui/FloatingInput.jsx: Removed internal hasDomValue state and native DOM listeners that caused the first-character re-render race condition. Simplified floating logic to pure declarative props.value and CSS rules. Adjusted input padding from pt-6 pb-2 to pt-5 pb-1.5 for vertical clearance. Upgraded focus glow to BukSU Royal Blue (#1A448A) in light mode and Academic Gold (#E5A823) in dark mode.

verification.autofill_credential_floating_test: PASSED (Zero overlap verified with Playwright bounding rects on filled email and password inputs)
